bug: Live nested projection consumption treated missing word-version markers as legacy even when word methods remained present. Startup/restore already required complete capability absence. Thus partial live capabilities could silently fall back to scalar transport.

reproduction.command: npm exec --workspace @breditor/browser -- vitest run src/wasm_projection_adapter.test.ts -t 'rejects orphan'
reproduction.observation: Each scalar word method and the signed integer word method, independently present without markers on a valid legacy view, was wrongly admitted.

fix: Use the shared captured, receiver-preserving all-or-none word capability admission in live semantic snapshots as well as startup/restore. No generated prototype mutation, repeated marker reads, fallback after invalid admission or change to base/flat capability probing.

regressions.cleanup: Invalid live child and update parent freed exactly once; orphan methods never invoked.

optIn.scope: Short installed-consumer success does not override the independent stress failure.
